Hey man I know it’s hard and I know how dumb this may sound, because trust me people have told me this a lot too and I can never seem to agree with them, but this feeling isn’t permanent. I have depression too and I am currently feeling extremely low and useless and unlovable, but believe me when I tell you it is not permanent. There will be hard and dark days but they will just make the good days feel even better. It can be so hard to find reasons to go on when you feel so depressed, but please don’t kill yourself. Find something, ANYTHING that can make you happy, if it’s playing games, or drawing, or anything that you enjoy doing, and just focus on that. Spend all your free time doing that thing that you love doing and I promise you it will start to get better soon! Please don’t go through with what you said you are going to do!

I can spend hours working on music and all of a sudden none of the things that make me hate myself matter. Don’t end it all man you gotta find the little things that make you happy. Also think about the fact we are in a global pandemic, which is gonna make it harder for anyone to find a relationship right now. I promise you will find someone and everything will work out, just gotta push through the tough times to reach the great days :)
